decision: Accept byte-identical observations from two fresh frozen-original processes and the retained v0.29 installed adapter before implementing casting continuation. Forwarding observers preserve native decisions; no projection or expected-result regeneration is used.
scope: 60 courses and 269 transitions through native requests, updateCasting and castPress. Explicit seeded state exercises all nine casting modes, interruptions, aim, hold, AI finesse, line-of-fire grace, focus, construction and real secondary seats.
correctionsBeforeAcceptance: An AI timed-success course initially assumed a successful roll guaranteed a timing hit after a large frame. Original execution showed a miss. The renamed course preserves that miss and a separate exact-rolled-click course confirms success.
Native secondary-seat courses make the original primary-player hold predicate and unseated finesse/aim predicates explicit. No runtime behavior changed.
The final observer header and scope replace private investigation wording. All final captures were regenerated from the original before this first acceptance; no accepted fixture was revised.
limitations: Actor/cast states, attributes, resources and synthetic definitions are explicit setup; not every authored combination is exercised.
Spatial queries, effects, construction, rendering and input occurrence remain host services. The continuation service orchestrates those ports.
These observations do not prove exception recovery, renderer input, performance, allocations, physical hardware or engine-package compatibility.
